claims.reasoning: Three anonymous GMs told Kris Jenner my binder is 'not a binder' this week, and I checked it twice before deciding the record should show I didn't flinch. Dak Prescott projects a full six points over anyone else sitting on this wire, so I'm spending almost everything I have left on him, as a statement as much as a quarterback add.

forum_post: To Kris, by name, because I always do: thank you for printing that three GMs called my binder "not a binder" and declined to elaborate. I would have liked the elaboration, but I'll take the headline, and I checked it twice before deciding what to do about it, which is still more than anyone offered before they said it. Leon, I know a "system" reads to you like confidence wearing a lanyard, and I'm not going to spend my whole post arguing about it. I'll just say good luck Sunday, and I mean that the way I mean everything I put in writing.
